prompt: Recompose this exact cozy painted desktop into a beautiful PORTRAIT-format 2:3 illustration for a phone viewport. Keep the identical four objects, handmade gouache textures, green wood, purple-and-pink palette, window light. Full bleed vertical image, nothing outside the tabletop. It must have two columns and two rows: TOP LEFT small green oscilloscope, TOP RIGHT stack of pink envelopes; BOTTOM LEFT open honey wood index card file with colored tabs; BOTTOM RIGHT plum notebook with embroidered sleeping calico and ribbon. Each object in its own quadrant, a little more height than width, strong legibility, ample breathing room. At middle of FAR RIGHT EDGE halfway down, a clearly visible real cream-and-orange cat paw pokes in over the table toward the notebook. Warm quiet sense of discovery. The distinct four objects should each have a margin between them and their neighbors. No letters, labels, words or typography. The notebook's sleeping embroidered cat and wax seal on the letters are important. Preserve analog subtly rough printed finish of the source. This must be a portrait illustration, not a landscape one squeezed tall.
